usageNotes: Use this to enumerate all roles defined in the cluster, including built-in roles (marked with special: true) and any custom roles created by administrators. Accessible by all authenticated users, so no elevated privilege is required. The returned privs field is a comma-separated list of privileges assigned to each role, useful for auditing permission scope before assigning a role to a user or group.

examples.summary: List all roles in the cluster

tips: Built-in roles (Administrator, PVEVMAdmin, PVEAuditor, etc.) have special: true and cannot be deleted or modified.
Custom roles have special: false or omit the field; these can be managed via create/update/delete role endpoints.
Cross-reference roleid values here with ACL entries from get_access_acl to understand effective permissions for a user or path.
